name: pull_suitcase
text: A person walks straight forward continuously pulling a wheeled suitcase with the right hand behind the right hip. Right arm slopes backward and down and remains steady. Left arm swings normally at the side. Regular forward walking with no gestures and no stops.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 右臂斜向后下方，手维持在髋后拉箱把手的位置，左臂自然摆动；修正版以提袋走的右手向后24厘米、向上3厘米约束生成。箱体轮地接触需接入端匹配。
